author: Widogeist
body: If the rate was changed, it's probably to help prevent players from abusing their spawn mechanic.  They used to spawn based on how active an area was; this means players could create multiple alt accounts and log them in a few times per day to greatly increase the chances of fountains/shrines to spawn; this also works (worked?) with getting new buildings to spawn, including dungeons.
